modules.name: Operational Essentials
modules.description: Mandatory operational baseline questions used for intensity-based assessments.

subModules.name: Mandatory Operational Questions
subModules.description: Operational questions explicitly required in the intensity template.

questions.text: Do you continue to experience production defects after every release?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. Mature teams should not accept recurring release defects as normal.

questions.text: Do your automation scripts break frequently when the application changes?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. Automation should be resilient to normal application change.

questions.text: Are enterprise tools available and consistently adopted across QA?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Good, Partial=Partial, No=Zero. Shared tooling should be available and used consistently across QA delivery.

questions.text: Have you fully adopted AI in your QA practices?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Good, Partial=Partial, No=Zero. Practical AI capabilities should already be in routine QA use where appropriate.

modules.name: Operational Essentials
modules.description: Mandatory operational baseline questions used for intensity-based assessments.

subModules.name: Mandatory Operational Questions
subModules.description: Operational questions explicitly required in the intensity template.

questions.text: Do you still use Time & Materials (T&M) or fixed-price contracts for testing instead of outcome-based engagement models?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. Mature operating models move away from pure effort-based testing contracts.

questions.text: Do QA teams still work in silos, separate from product and delivery streams?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. QA should be integrated with product and delivery streams.

questions.text: Do you lack a formal QA governance model across programs?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. This follows the requested diagnostic scoring rule.

questions.text: Do you conduct periodic test maturity assessments?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Good, Partial=Partial, No=Zero. Maturity should be assessed regularly to drive improvement.

modules.name: Operational Essentials
modules.description: Mandatory operational baseline questions used for intensity-based assessments.

subModules.name: Mandatory Operational Questions
subModules.description: Operational questions explicitly required in the intensity template.

questions.text: Do you still identify defects late in the STLC, such as during Dev, SIT, UAT, or Pre-Prod, rather than earlier in the SDLC?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. Defects should be caught earlier in the SDLC.

questions.text: Do regression cycles still require manual effort despite automation coverage?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. Regression should not rely on manual effort when automation is claimed.

questions.text: Do you have a documented test strategy that is consistently followed?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Good, Partial=Partial, No=Zero. Test strategy should be documented and consistently followed.

questions.text: Is your UAT process primarily manual?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. UAT should be structured and supported with as much automation as practical.

modules.name: Operational Essentials
modules.description: Mandatory operational baseline questions used for intensity-based assessments.

subModules.name: Mandatory Operational Questions
subModules.description: Operational questions explicitly required in the intensity template.

questions.text: Do you measure your team's productivity and year-over-year productivity improvements?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Good, Partial=Partial, No=Zero. Productivity should be measured and improved over time.

questions.text: Do you have a competency development plan for each team member?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Good, Partial=Partial, No=Zero. Each resource should have a clear development plan.

questions.text: Is testing still performed primarily by human testers rather than AI agents?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Zero, Partial=Partial, No=Good. The work should not rely entirely on people where AI agents can assist appropriately.

questions.text: Do you have an investment plan for continuous QA training and upskilling?
questions.guidance: Scoring: Yes=Good, Partial=Partial, No=Zero. Continuous QA training and upskilling should be adequately funded.
